base_note: origin/develop at 28 Oct 2026, 'docs: D-118 the website names the child ... (#307)'. Line numbers below are post-image lines (the file as it reads after the patch is applied).

defects.description: entries_select drops the is_child_member(child_id) check, so any signed-in user reads every family's in-book entries, including raw_transcript.
verifyEdits skips checkEdit for source 'rule', so a rule edit that adds meaning is applied unverified (constitution: no bypass).
Onboarding copy promises a nightly rhythm and a streak; rules.test.ts fails on both the fear/guilt and the daily-rhythm rules.
isTrusted accepts any account whose login ends in [bot] instead of checking user.type === 'Bot', so a human can register such a login and be trusted by the harness.
Edits a migration already applied to the live database; the change never reaches it. Must be a new migration (CLAUDE.md, migration-guard).
console.warn writes the child's name to the device log (privacy rule: no child name in logs or crash reports).
